name: weibo/web-v2/hot-search-index
description: Returns the top 10 hot search ranking items currently trending on Weibo. It delivers active search topics without requiring any input parameters.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme: # Weibo Hot Search Index API Returns the current Weibo hot search ranking as a list of trending topics, each with its rank, label and a numeric heat value. It needs no input, so send an empty JSON object `{}`. ## Use cases - Show the current top Weibo topics on a media monitoring dashboard. - Log the ranking at set times to see which topics enter or leave the list. - Flag topics carrying a `新` (new) label to catch fresh stories early. - Build search links to open the Weibo results page for each trending topic. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/weibo/web-v2/hot-search-index" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "hotgovs": [ { "emoticon_url": "", "flag": 2, "icon": "https://simg.s.weibo.com/moter/flags/2_0.png", "icon_desc": "热", "icon_desc_color": "#ff9406", "icon_height": 24, "icon_info": "热", "icon_width": 24, "name": "乌镇网事", "pos": 1, "search_url": "/weibo?q=%23%E4%B9%8C%E9%95%87%E7%BD%91%E4%BA%8B%23&Refer=new_time", "show_idx": 1 } ], "list": [ { "description": "2173490", "emoticon": "", "emoticon_url": "", "flag": 2, "icon": "https://simg.s.weibo.com/moter/flags/2_0.png", "icon_desc": "热", "icon_desc_color": "#ff9406", "icon_height": 24, "icon_info": "热", "icon_width": 24, "label_name": "热", "note": "赴港看演唱会女孩低保已被取消" } ] } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `list[].word / list[].note` | The topic text as shown in the ranking. Both hold the same phrase in the sample. | | `list[].word_scheme` | The topic wrapped in `#` hashtag marks, for example `#赴港看演唱会女孩低保已被取消#`. | | `list[].num / list[].description` | The numeric heat value for the topic. `description` holds the same number as a string. | | `list[].realpos / list[].show_idx` | The rank position of the topic in the list, starting at `1`. | | `list[].label_name / list[].icon_desc` | The short label on the topic, such as `热` (hot) or `新` (new). | | `list[].flag` | A numeric code for the label type. In the sample, `2` goes with `热` and `1` goes with `新`. | | `list[].icon / list[].icon_desc_color` | The label icon image URL and the hex color used for the label. | | `list[].search_url` | A relative Weibo search path for the topic. It carries the encoded hashtag query and the `band_rank` value. | | `hotgovs[].word / hotgovs[].pos` | A separate short list of topics with their position. The sample shows one item with `pos` set to `1`. | | `hotgovs[].search_url` | A relative Weibo search path for the topic in `hotgovs`. | ## Notes - The request takes no parameters. Send `{}` as the body. - The `search_url` values are relative paths that start with `/weibo?q=`. Add the Weibo host yourself to build a full link. - For a longer ranking, try [Weibo Real-Time Hot Search](/apis/weibo/web-v2/hot-search) or [Weibo Hot Search List](/apis/weibo/web-v2/hot-search-summary). - To find posts about a topic, pass its `word` to [Weibo Topic Search](/apis/weibo/web-v2/topic-search). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Weibo Advanced Search](/apis/weibo/web-v2/advanced-search): Search Weibo posts by keyword with filters for time range, post type (hot, original, verified, media) and content type (images, video, links). - [Weibo AI Related Search Content](/apis/weibo/web-v2/ai-related-search): Returns AI-generated content extensions for a keyword, including related questions, recommended bloggers, and reference posts. - [Weibo AI Search](/apis/weibo/web-v2/ai-search): Returns multimodal search results and relevance scores from Weibo intelligent search for a specified keyword or topic query.
